title: ADR-008: brapi (plano gratuito) como fonte master; Yahoo como backup
summary: Decides brapi free plan as master source for daily candles and spot quotes under a request budget, with Yahoo as backup and sole intraday source.
notes: Status field reads 'Aceito em direção' (non-standard phrasing for Accepted) with one explicit pending item (spot delay measurement during live trading hours); treated as Accepted/locked since the decision itself is finalized and only a downstream measurement remains open. Document also contains a later dated addendum (11/08/2026, noite) amending scope for the agent execution cycle — still part of the same locked ADR.
